why_N_stays_11: The frozen requirement assumes independent conditions and fully correlated pairs within a condition. The amended design makes the first assumption true (DESIGN_CHECK.json C1-C5), so the frozen calculation applies unchanged and 11 is still the smallest count meeting it. Nothing was re-tuned to keep 11.
reading: Between-condition correlation inflates the frozen rule's false-positive rate above its nominal 0.05, which is why independence must hold by construction rather than be assumed. At rho_b = 0 the rate is at most 0.05.
